description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Necrogen Communion triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Necrogen Communion from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Repeat.
